Topline: mid-to-enterprise e-comm platform (vertical: apparel + marketplace sellers) exploring semantic product search + LLM rerank to improve conversion on long-tail queries. Key constraints: indexing scale (~50M SKUs), target cost-per-query, and ability to absorb 4-6x seasonal traffic spikes.

Discovery highlights:

Technical requirements / targets:
- Index size: ~50M active SKUs; monthly churn ~4%.

- Latency SLOs: cold-search p95 < 200ms; rerank end-to-end p95 < 350ms (target prefer <250ms).
- Cost goal: average cost per query (retrieval + 3-pass rerank) <= $0.003-0.006 depending on traffic (goal for scale).
